thread:
maria: Quick UX question — where should the 'Download invoice' CTA live on the consumption page? Current mock puts it top-right next to filters but with the compact spend cards it reads like an action on the whole page rather than the invoice. Screenshot attached :camera_flash:
daniel: Agree re hierarchy. Discovery vs clutter. My gut: group export actions in the header, keep primary CTA labelled. On mobile collapse to a single kebab menu. :mobile_phone_off
priya: +1 but accessibility note — icon-only CTAs lose affordance. If we move it to a header group make sure label is visible on focus and add aria-label. Keyboard users need a clear tab stop.
alex: Also thinking about the token breakdown viz — donut vs sparkline. Donut looks nice for a single snapshot but hides temporal trends. For usage drilling I prefer inline sparklines with a small stacked bar per project.
maria: What if we do a hybrid: compact card shows sparkline + small %; expanded card or hover shows donut and detailed legend. That keeps dashboard scanable but preserves deeper viz.
daniel: Works for me. Another point: legend contrast — current colors are too close for colorblind folks. Suggest we pick color palette with WCAG contrast in mind and add textual % next to each legend item.
priya: Please don't rely on color alone. Also add patterns or small icons to legend swatches for low-vision modes. And ensure legend is tabbable with aria-describedby tying to the chart.
alex: Mock aria snippet: ```html
<button class="download-invoice" aria-label="Download invoice (CSV)">Download</button>
```
That plus visible label on focus should cover most screen readers.
ken: One more: org vs project scope toggle. Right now it's a tiny toggle that people miss. Maybe show a short breadcrumb: "Viewing: Organization — AcmeCorp (change)" so it's clear what scope the spend numbers reflect.
maria: Good call. Breadcrumb + small help tooltip explaining difference. Also for org admins default to org, project members default to project view.
daniel: :thumbsup: Agree on sensible defaults.
billing-bot: Invoice generation succeeded for acct-1234, PDF ready for download: https://redwood.example/invoices/2025-07-acct-1234.pdf
priya: Small copy tweak request — instead of "Download invoice" use "Download invoice (PDF)" so it's explicit in the action list.
maria: Nice. Also thinking about placement: put primary "Download invoice (PDF)" as a filled button and secondary "Export CSV" as link-style. Keeps emphasis on the legal artifact.
daniel: UX nit: on the compact spend cards, reduce top padding so the sparkline aligns with project name baseline. Tiny but helps scan.
alex: I'll sketch quick comps: variant A = header CTA + hybrid viz, variant B = inline download per-account card. Will drop in figma by EOD.
maria: Can folks review in #design-review tomorrow? Ping me if you can't. Thanks all!
